visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase the contrast between water and road to improve visibility.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not easily distinguishable against the ground color.
visualRisks.suggestion: Change the lighthouse color or increase its size for better visibility.

navigationRisks.description: The route path includes a sudden change in direction that might be hard to follow, especially with limited visual cues.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Smooth out the route transitions or add more visual markers.

navigationRisks.description: There are multiple dead ends and loops in the route which could confuse players.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Review the route to ensure it is linear and intuitive for navigation.
